title: Qi'ra
description: Qi'ra grew up in the White Worms criminal gang alongside Han Solo. While Qi'ra and Han planned to escape Corellia together, the two were separated at the Spaceport, with Qi'ra left behind. Eventually she became the right hand of Dryden Vos, public face of the Crimson Dawn crime syndicate. She joined Han for the raid on Kessel, and later saved his life from Vos. With Vos gone, Qi'ra became the public face of Crimson Dawn at the bidding of its true master, Maul.
